p2.note: Source ends with dangling "هَذَا" whose continuation (كتاب) belongs to 7:2; TR/EN render it faithfully.

p1.note: Turkish rendered "قُبُلُهُ وَقُبُلُ الْآخَرِ وَدُبُرُهُ" as own front, other front and rear (rear attributed to the other); changed to own front, other front, own rear, matching the Arabic pronoun and the English.
English rendered مُخَفَّفًا وَمُشَدَّدًا as "with light and with doubled form"; changed to "in the lightened form and the doubled (shadda) form".
Turkish said "Cebrâil'in atının ayağının izinden" for حَافِرِ جِبْرِيلَ (added "horse" and "track"); changed to "Cebrâil'in toynağından".

For ﴿وَاتَّبَعَ هَوَاهُ﴾ فِي دُعَائِهِ إِلَيْهَا the referent of the pronoun in دُعَائِهِ is ambiguous: Turkish reads it as desire calling him to it ("onun kendisini ona çağırmasında"), English as "his invoking toward it"; I cannot verify which is intended.
